title: ICC told to assess whether Duterte’s ‘kill’ remarks are a Visayan quirk
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) should determine if former President Rodrigo Duterte’s “kill” remarks are just a Visayan way of emphasis, which has been “misread” by…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) should determine if former President Rodrigo Duterte’s “kill” remarks are just a Visayan way of emphasis, which has been “misread” by outsiders in Manila and abroad.
